bca_potential_max_districts = {
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_districts
        parameters = {
            type = any
        }
        mode = set
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = {
            type = any
        }
        mode = add
    }
    add = value:bca_num_queued_districts
    # set = value:bca_planet_max_districts
}


bca_num_free_secondary_districts_plan = {
    set = value:bca_potential_max_districts
    subtract = value:bca_committed_primary_district
    subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
    subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
    subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
}


bca_num_free_secondary_districts_plan_full_secondary_districts = {
    set = value:bca_potential_max_districts
    subtract = 1
    subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
    subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
    subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
}


# 2026-11-15 修复：按「当前空余区划槽」收敛副区划方案。
# 旧逻辑用 bca_potential_max_districts（= 已建 + 空槽）做基值，等于把已建区划又算成可用槽，
# 于是一颗 19/20 的星球也能算出「还能再建 10 个区划」的假方案。
# 该值为负时表示方案超出空槽（至少给城市留 1 个槽），由 bca_resource_planet_controller 逐级扣减。
bca_num_free_districts_for_secondary_plan = {
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = {
            type = any
        }
        mode = set
    }
    # 2026-11-16：原式漏加了「已建次级区划」——方案数是目标总量，不是增量，
    # 不减掉已建部分就等于把已建的区划再算一次占用，导致手动设 4 被压回 3。
    add = value:bca_committed_secondary_district
    subtract = value:bca_num_secondary_districts_plan
    # 只有在城市区划确实还想增长时才预留 1 个槽，否则不预留。
    modifier = {
        add = -1
        check_variable_arithmetic = {
            which = value:bca_num_primary_districts_plan
            value > value:bca_committed_primary_district
        }
    }
}

# 2026-11-21：给城市/枢纽留出保留额度。
# 次级区划方案总和不得超过「容量 - 保留」，保留 = max(3, 容量的 1/4)。
# 之前没有这条限制，科研/统一星球被发电/采矿区划吃满，城市区划只剩 1 个，
# 建筑槽与特区槽都长不出来，星球的方向就失去了意义。
bca_secondary_plan_reserve = {
    set = value:bca_potential_max_districts
    divide = 4
    min = 3
}

bca_num_free_districts_for_secondary_plan_reserved = {
    set = value:bca_num_free_districts_for_secondary_plan
    subtract = value:bca_secondary_plan_reserve
}

    add = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
    add = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
    add = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
    subtract = value:bca_committed_secondary_district
}


bca_num_primary_districts_plan = {
    set = value:bca_potential_max_districts
    modifier = {
        subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
        is_variable_set = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
    }
    modifier = {
        subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
        is_variable_set = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
    }
    modifier = {
        subtract = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
        is_variable_set = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
    }
    # 主区划（城市）方案上限守卫：任何副区划方案异常都不允许把城市方案抬到星球区划容量之上，
    # 否则自动化会持续认为"还缺城市区划"而无限建设城市区划。
    min = 1
    max = value:bca_potential_max_districts
}


bca_num_secondary_districts_plan = {
    modifier = {
        add = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
        is_variable_set = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
    }
    modifier = {
        add = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
        is_variable_set = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
    }
    modifier = {
        add = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
        is_variable_set = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5

    min = 0
}

    # 2026-11-15：非一产专精的星球根本不会写这三个方案变量，直接 add 会刷
    # "Variable bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3 is not set for scoped planet"（点比例按钮时 54 条/次）。
    modifier = {
        is_variable_set = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3

    set = value:num_district_d0

# 2026-11-15：城市（d0）拆除阈值 = 已建 - 1，留 1 的容差。
# 原来用严格的 plan < 已建，方案只要比现状少 1 就会举牌拆除；拆掉一个后空出的槽位又让方案回升，
# 于是出现「拆中央枢纽 → 建中央枢纽」的循环（玩家反馈：伊特拉本-I 铸造星）。
bca_num_primary_district_remove_threshold = {
    # 2026-11-15 晚：容差从 1 提到 2。方案 = 容量 − 三方案和，容量随排队/完工抖动，
    # 差 1 就拆会让城市区划在边界上反复拆建。
    set = value:num_district_d0
    subtract = 2
    min = 0
}

    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_zones
        parameters = {
            type = zone_urban
        }
        mode = add
    }
}


num_primary_zone_plan_of_type_urban = {
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z1_urban
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z2_urban
        add = 1
    }
}


num_secondary_zones_of_type_urban = {
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_zones
        parameters = {
            type = zone_subterranean_urban
        }
        mode = add
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_zones
        parameters = {
            type = zone_agrarian_anglers
        }
        mode = add
    }
}


num_secondary_zone_plan_of_type_urban = {
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z3_urban
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
            value > 0
        }
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z4_urban
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
            value > 0
        }
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_type_z5_urban
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
            value > 0
        }
        add = 1
    }

        trigger = num_zones
        parameters = {
            type = zone_industrial
        }
        mode = add
    }
}


num_zone_plan_of_zone_industrial = {
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z1_zone_industrial
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z2_zone_industrial
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_industrial
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
            value > 0
        }
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z4_zone_industrial
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
            value > 0
        }
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z5_zone_industrial
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5
            value > 0
        }
        add = 1
    }
}

        trigger = num_zones
        parameters = {
            type = zone_research_arcology
        }
        mode = add
    }
}


num_zone_plan_of_zone_research_arcology = {
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z1_zone_research_arcology
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z2_zone_research_arcology
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z3_zone_research_arcology
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z3
            value > 0
        }
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z4_zone_research_arcology
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z4
            value > 0
        }
        add = 1
    }
    modifier = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_selected_zone_z5_zone_research_arcology
        check_variable = {
            which = bca_ps_plan_district_count_z5

# ====================================================================
# 2026-11-15（E）：副区划「目标数」兜底
# bca_district_max_build_d* 只取 modifier:district_*_max_add（星球上的区划容量加成），
# 在部分星球类型上这个值会小于实际还能建的数量（仓库世界/机械世界/轨道居住站等）。
# 结果就是方案被钳到「已建数量」，建造条件 plan > committed 永远为假 ——
# 玩家看到的「明明还有 10 个区划可建，自动化却一直不动」。
# 这里用游戏自身的 num_free_districts 兜底：
#     目标数 = max(原容量, 该族已建 + 该族剩余可建位)
# 下限仍为已建数量，保证不会因为兜底反而触发拆除。
# ====================================================================
bca_free_district_d1 = {
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_generator }
        mode = set
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_geothermal }
        mode = add
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_hab_energy }
        mode = add
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_photosynthesis_fields }
        mode = add
    }
}


bca_free_district_d2 = {
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_mining }
        mode = set
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_melting }
        mode = add
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_hab_mining }
        mode = add
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_hollow_mountains }
        mode = add
    }
}


bca_free_district_d3 = {
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_farming }
        mode = set
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_polytechnic }
        mode = add
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_hab_science }
        mode = add
    }
    complex_trigger_modifier = {
        trigger = num_free_districts
        parameters = { type = district_orchard_forests }
        mode = add
    }
}


bca_district_total_d1 = {
    add = value:num_district_d1
    add = value:bca_free_district_d1
}


bca_district_total_d2 = {
    add = value:num_district_d2
    add = value:bca_free_district_d2
}


bca_district_total_d3 = {
    add = value:num_district_d3
    add = value:bca_free_district_d3
}


bca_target_district_d1 = {
    set = value:bca_district_total_d1
    # min 在脚本数值里是「下限」语义，等价于 max(当前值, 该值)：
    # 容量加成比「已建 + 可建」小时不起作用，比它大时仍以容量为准（保持旧行为）。
    min = value:bca_district_max_build_d1
    max = value:bca_planet_max_districts
}


bca_target_district_d2 = {
    set = value:bca_district_total_d2
    # min 在脚本数值里是「下限」语义，等价于 max(当前值, 该值)：
    # 容量加成比「已建 + 可建」小时不起作用，比它大时仍以容量为准（保持旧行为）。
    min = value:bca_district_max_build_d2
    max = value:bca_planet_max_districts
}


bca_target_district_d3 = {
    set = value:bca_district_total_d3
    # min 在脚本数值里是「下限」语义，等价于 max(当前值, 该值)：
    # 容量加成比「已建 + 可建」小时不起作用，比它大时仍以容量为准（保持旧行为）。
    min = value:bca_district_max_build_d3
    max = value:bca_planet_max_districts
}

# 2026-11-15：BCA_MAIN_DISTRICT_RATIO_DISPLAY 引用了这三个数值，
# 但定义缺失，导致界面一直显示 0/0|0/0。这里用已有数值做别名。
bca_num_primary_district = {
    set = value:bca_committed_district_d0
}


bca_num_primary_district_plan = {
    set = value:bca_num_primary_districts_plan
}


bca_num_secondary_district = {
    set = value:bca_committed_secondary_district
}

# 2026-11-15: 次级槽按钮显示的「可用槽数」，手动方案可超额，显示值不允许为负。
bca_num_free_secondary_districts_plan_display = {
    set = value:bca_num_free_secondary_districts_plan
    min = 0
}


# 2026-11-16: 星球尺寸暴露成脚本数值，供 scripted_loc 显示（defined_text 只能读 value:X）。
bca_planet_size_value = {
    base = 0
    add = trigger:planet_size
}

# 2026-11-16：高级星球（机械/纳米/蜂巢/环世界/城市世界）的副区划真实产出按 zone 统计，
# 而不是按 district_nexus_1/2/3 的层级统计——层级与产出无关，用它做「已建」会永远对不上方案。
bca_adv_zone_energy = {
    set = value:num_zones_of_zone_energy_nexus
}
bca_adv_zone_minerals = {
    set = value:num_zones_of_zone_minerals_nexus
}
# 高级星球逐月步进目标：每次只比已建多 1，缺口补上就停，避免一次性把方案抬到满容量。
bca_adv_zone_energy_next = {
    set = value:num_zones_of_zone_energy_nexus
    add = 1
}
bca_adv_zone_minerals_next = {
    set = value:num_zones_of_zone_minerals_nexus
    add = 1
}
bca_adv_food_next = {
    set = value:bca_committed_district_d3
    add = 1
}
